# E0371: a lens may divide by zero

A lens divides by a field that may be zero, which is an error in CUE, so the
lens fails on every instance where it is. Exclude zero from the divisor's
schema, or test for it.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: int32
				d: int32
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				q: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			q: quo(v0_0.n, v0_0.d)
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			n: 0
			d: 1
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0371]: q in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 divides by v0_0.d, which may be 0
  --> lineage.cue:23:11
   |
23 |             q: quo(v0_0.n, v0_0.d)
   |                    ^^^^
   |
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule division-by-zero)
```
